name: satellite-wp-theme
description: Build tooling for the Satellite WordPress theme — compiles src/scss/style.scss to style.css (Sass, Autoprefixer, cssnano) and minifies js/src/*.js to js/*.min.js (terser).

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js

author: Milena Rolfes (https://github.com/MimiRolfes)
